cases.proves_bugs: BUG-657 (Edit Pipe route: one of the pipe's two level texts on a locked layer, so neither is written and the pipe is named)
cases.title: With the end level text of P82 -> P83 on a locked layer, Recalculate downstream from an Edit Pipe on P81 -> P82 changes neither of that pipe's level texts and names the pipe as not updated
cases.plan_item: Bug-proof plan wave 1 (BUG_PROOF_PLAN_31OCT.md), group E: the cascade and a locked level-text layer
cases.expected: Three pits P81, P82, P83 and pipes P81->P82 (18.300 / 18.200) and P82->P83 (18.150 / 18.050), no Grade mismatch window. The text 'IL 18.050' moves to layer E3LOCK and E3LOCK is locked. Edit Pipe on P81->P82 with 18.40 / 18.30, Save, Recalculate Yes, Cascade Preview Apply: the command line says 'Nothing was changed - no pipe could be updated (P82 -> P83). The levels on the drawing and in the schedule are as they were.' and no 'Updated' line; the CE log says the invert text 'could not be updated to 18.15'. The P82->P83 texts still read IL 18.150 and IL 18.050 (the locked one still on E3LOCK); no text reads IL 18.25. E3LOCK is unlocked again at the end. No CE window is left open; the drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: IlTextWriteGateTests prove the all-or-nothing rule with stand-ins; only a live drawing has AutoCAD's real locked-layer refusal on a real CE level text inside the real cascade.
not_automated: The other order (the START text locked, the end text open) is not driven: before the fix both orders wrote the open text, after it neither; one order is enough to see the difference. CDPROPAGATE is not driven.
The pipe's stored record (18.150 / 18.050) and the Pit Schedule are not read; that 'the record was left as it was' rests on the CE line and log.

DERIVED, not yet seen on a run: every line and level above; that CHPROP of a CE level text to another layer is left there by CE (checked below: its layer is read back); that the robot's typed -LAYER _NEW makes the layer (the _LOCK / _UNLOCK forms are R33's).
